rounding_note: SS2D projection einsums are counted exactly from traced tensor dimensions, avoiding numpy.einsum_path three-significant-digit rounding in the legacy fvcore handler.
convention: Paper MAC convention: conv/linear/matmul/einsum plus explicit propagation. Excludes normalization, activations, pooling, resizing, gates, readout elementwise operations, and layout operations. SS2D core uses official prefixsum estimate; CPU count-only core preserves projection shapes, not numerical output. No GPU timing or inference quality measured.
module_scope: Entire AttBlock.attn replacement, including its input/output projection and coefficient generation; excludes carrier FFN and other backbone operations.
haze4k: Same dehazing model structure as O-HAZE; same counts at the same input shape.
